Container.Name: Antigravity CLI
Container.Overview: Headless remote connection server for Google Antigravity. Run the autonomous DeepMind AI coding agent 24/7 on your Unraid server and seamlessly connect from your Antigravity Desktop App, IDE, or browser. Offload heavy code indexing, compiler toolchains (Python 3, Node.js, Git, build-essential, Docker CLI), and multi-agent execution directly to your server with persistent credentials and automated Google updates.
Container.Description:
[b]Antigravity CLI (agy) Remote Execution Server[/b]
Turn your Unraid server into a high-performance remote compute host for [b]Google Antigravity[/b]. Connect from the Antigravity Desktop App, IDE, or web browser to dispatch autonomous coding tasks, run background subagents, and compile software without consuming local laptop battery or CPU.
[b]Key Remote Capabilities:[/b] • [b]Seamless Remote Connection:[/b] Automatically hosts the [i]agy remote-control[/i] daemon, exposing this Unraid instance directly inside your Antigravity Desktop app and web dashboard under Remote Instances. • [b]Persistent Authentication:[/b] One-time headless Google OAuth login saved directly in your appdata cache (/config), surviving container restarts and updates. • [b]Full Developer Toolchains:[/b] Preloaded with Node.js 22 LTS, Python 3, pip, python-venv, Git, build-essential (gcc/g++/make), jq, and Docker CLI. • [b]Zero-Friction Permissions:[/b] Maps cleanly to Unraid nobody:users (PUID=99, PGID=100) to ensure code modifications in /workspaces never cause permission issues. • [b]RAM-Speed Builds:[/b] Pre-configured with host /dev/shm shared memory and high-speed tmpfs for ultra-fast compiler performance.
[b]Initial One-Time Setup:[/b] 1. Start the container and open the Unraid WebGUI Console for this container. 2. Run [b]agy[/b] and follow the terminal link to sign in with your Google account. 3. Once authenticated, the container automatically registers your instance name and runs the remote daemon 24/7. 4. Open the Antigravity Desktop App or Web UI, go to Remote Instances, select your Unraid instance, and start coding!

Config.Name: Appdata / Config
Config.Description: Container home directory. Stores persistent Google auth tokens (.gemini/), preferences, SSH keys, and shell history. TIP: For fastest performance and to bypass Unraid's FUSE (shfs) overhead, map directly to your cache pool (e.g. /mnt/cache/appdata/antigravity).

Config.Name: Projects / Workspaces
Config.Description: Working directory where your code repositories and Unraid shares reside for the agent to access. TIP: For fastest build, git, and indexing speeds, map directly to your cache pool (e.g. /mnt/cache/projects) or use an Exclusive Share.

Config.Name: Shared Memory (RAM Buffer)
Config.Description: Mounts host shared memory to prevent Chromium, headless browser tools, and compiler workers from crashing or falling back to slow disk.

Config.Name: Docker Socket (Optional)
Config.Description: Mount host docker socket if you want Antigravity to be able to inspect or run docker containers.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file ownership inside container (default 99 matches Unraid nobody user).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file ownership inside container (default 100 matches Unraid users group).

Config.Name: Instance Name
Config.Description: Instance name displayed when connecting via Antigravity Remote.

Config.Name: Auto Start Daemon
Config.Description: Automatically launch agy remote-control background daemon on container boot.

Config.Name: Auto Update
Config.Description: Automatically query Google release manifests and update agy binary on container start and periodically.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone for accurate log timestamps.
